To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the energy and electricity use for ICT networks and datacenters is best predicted based on data traffic and that the primary energy use for computing is estimated for the first time.

the global energy and power use of ICT networks can be best estimated by data traffic and data traffic per capita, while the power use of computing can be best estimated from the number of operations per capita.

(i) data traffic is a more stable AM than subscribers, (ii) the energy intensity of ICT networks is decreasing, (iii) the global ICT networks and data center electricity use is increasing, and (iv) the primary energy use for computing is negligible compared to the global energy use.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the energy use of ICT networks (fixed and mobile) and data centers.
the development of a high-level, simplified, but robust approach for estimating the global energy and power usage of ICT networks and Data Centers.
the following: (1) The development of a top-down approach based on data traffic for estimating the energy use of ICT networks (including data centers) for 2025/2030.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the data traffic AM is best suited for predicting energy evolution of networks.
the most reliable and robust approach to estimate the energy use of ICT networks, data centers and computing is to use the data traffic as the AM.

(i) data traffic based AM is the best suited AM for predicting future electricity use of networks; (ii) the data traffic AM can be combined with a CAGR to predict the future electricity use of the network; (iii) the electricity use of the data center is not predictable by data traffic AM but by the total number of operations; (iv) the electricity use for computing is not predictable by the total number or instructions but by the energy per instruction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the global electricity use (TWh) of fixed, mobile, data center and cloud networks is predicted by the data traffic AM to increase from 1.3% to 2.3% of the global electricity use from 2020 to 2030.
data traffic is the best AM for predicting the energy use of ICT Networks and data centers.
the global energy use of ICT networks is expected to increase from 0.7% in 2010, to 1.2% in 2020 and to 1.8% in 2030.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a more detailed analysis of the energy use and the energy intensity is needed to understand the energy use of ICT networks.
the data traffic is a robust AM to predict ICT network electricity use.
a data traffic based AM is the most reliable and accurate approach for predicting the future energy use of ICT networks.
